review_candidates.title: Enterprise Applications Architect
review_candidates.location: Ikast-Brande Municipality, Central Denmark Region, Denmark
review_candidates.description: Department: Strategy & Transformation Location: Australia Compensation: AU$173,000 - AU$208,000 / year Description Sensiba is seeking a strategic and "hands-on" Enterprise Applications Architect to serve as a vital link between our corporate technology stack and our firm's strategic evolution. We are on a journey to simplify our systems and elevate Salesforce from a traditional CRM into a comprehensive CRM+ERP ecosystem, ensuring it serves as the backbone for our firm-wide operations. This is a senior individual contributor role where the ideal candidate will act in a "player-coach" capacity, reporting directly to the Director of Organizational Systems and Change. You will be the advocate for master data management, system governance, and the solution architecture for how corporate technology is implemented and integrated across the firm. You will ensure that our technical foundations are scalable and aligned with our long-term vision of an outcome-led growth model. Your primary mission is to act as the bridge between various stakeholders to ensure our business operating system is aligned and effective. You will collaborate deeply with the Director of Business Insights to ensure data fluidity, and the RevOps team to ensure they are empowered with a high-performance sales and marketing machine — all while maintaining firm-wide governance. Crucially, you will collaborate with the Chief Product Officer and their team to execute our technical vision, calling on product engineering support for complex "plumbing" and integrations. This is a business-centric role that requires deep technical fluency to manage our cost footprint and ensure our technology investment stays commensurate with our allowable cost per FTE. It's not anticipated for this role to have any direct reports. Your effectiveness comes from influence, credibility, and the ability to build followership across the firm without formal authority. Key Responsibilities Architectural Strategy & Governance: Advocate for and design the solution architecture for all corporate technology. You will ensure that systems like Salesforce and Sage Intacct interact seamlessly to support our service lines and global regions. Technical Vision Execution: Work as an integral part of the technical team, collaborating with the Chief Product Officer and engineering to maintain and evolve our data and systems ecosystem. Documentation & Enablement: Create and maintain comprehensive, up-to-date documentation for all system configurations, business logic, and integration workflows. Establish firm-wide standards to ensure platform users are enabled and set up for success within predefined guardrails. Project & Contractor Oversight: Provide day-to-day direction on key projects delivered with third-party contractors, ensuring alignment with objectives, quality standards, and on-time, on-budget delivery. Not all projects will have contract resource assigned with some requiring the ideal candidate to roll up their sleeves and complete configuration themselves. Cross-Functional Solutioning: Partner with functional leaders across the firm to ensure our corporate tech stack supports the entire client and employee lifecycle. You will be part of the core team making critical "build vs. buy" decisions. Quote-to-Cash Orchestration: Own the logic that allows data to flow perfectly from a contract to an invoice, revenue recognition template, and billing schedule downstream. Integration Strategy: Determine the most effective integration paths, deciding when to utilize out-of-the-box solutions versus bespoke middleware to keep our ecosystem performant and scalable. Financial & Operational Stewardship: Act as a "Critical Friend" to the business, monitoring our technology cost footprint and ensuring our systems facilitate the transition from traditional productivity metrics to value-based outcomes. Master Data Advocacy: Establish and maintain the standards for data integrity and governance, ensuring that our systems provide high-fidelity insights for leadership decision-making. Skills, Knowledge and Expertise Education: Bachelor's degree in Business, Accounting, Finance, or a related field is preferred; a degree in IT or Technology is also welcomed. Salesforce (Required): Deep, hands-on, current experience in the Salesforce ecosystem is essential to this role; candidates without substantive Salesforce experience will not be considered. A Salesforce Administrator Certification is required (Advanced Admin, Platform App Builder, or Architect track certifications are highly advantageous). Experience: Significant experience in Business Systems, Solutions Architecture, or a similar role, with a track record of delivering, directing and quality-assuring the work of individual contractors or Salesforce professionals on projects. Experience in a global Professional Services or B2B environment is highly favorable. Industry Knowledge: Strong understanding of professional services operations and accounting principles, specifically Bookings vs. Billings vs. Revenue Recognition. Global Literacy: Experience understanding how geography and multi-entity structures create unique challenges for business operations and system configurations. Sage Intacct: Experience with Sage Intacct or equivalent ERP systems is highly favorable. System Ecosystems: Proven ability to manage and integrate corporate platforms including HRIS, Collaboration tools, and Financial systems. Influence Without Authority: You build followership and credibility across the firm without relying on formal reporting lines. Strategic Operations, the Business Insights team, and operational leads don't report to you — you get to outcomes through partnership and trust, not direction. The Holistic Systems Thinker: You look past individual features to see how a change in one system impacts the entire business operating system. You understand that scalability requires a "firm-first" mindset. The Collaborative Bridge: You are a rapport-builder who can translate executive strategy into technical requirements. You navigate the needs of different departments with diplomacy and a focus on aligned outcomes. Technically Pragmatic: You enjoy being "hands-on" with the stack. You see the value in clean integrations and are eager to contribute to the technical foundations that make great insights possible. Compensation & Benefits This role offers a competitive base salary along with a comprehensive benefits package. The anticipated salary ranges for this position are outlined below and are subject to change: $173,000 - $208,000 When determining compensation, we consider a variety of factors such as a candidate’s professional experience, skills, and qualifications. Please note that final offer amounts may vary from the ranges listed above and may be adjusted over time. There are many reasons to join the Sensiba team: market-leading leave entitlements, competitive compensation, professional advancement opportunities, and above all — our people. If you're looking for an environment that offers you growth, success, and professionalism without compromising your family, passions, and life outside of work, apply today! Sensiba has a robust offering of benefits, including: Market-Leading Annual Leave – We offer 30 days of Annual Leave (10 days above the Australian statutory requirement), plus an additional 5 days of paid leave for our firm's mid-year shutdown in July. You will also have access to personal/carer's leave, parental leave, and volunteer days. Salary Packaging & Novated Leasing – Minimise your taxable income and maximise your take-home pay through our novated leasing program for vehicles. Flexible & Remote Work – Enjoy the freedom of remote work with the option to connect in person. We provide WeWork subscriptions and access to local offices for team collaboration. Performance-Based Bonus – Recognition for your contributions through our annual discretionary bonus program. Professional Development – We invest in your future with tuition reimbursement, support for professional certifications (CA/CPA etc.), and structured mentorship. Tech of Your Choice – We offer your choice of a high-spec Mac or PC setup. Inclusive & Supportive Culture – DEI initiatives, employee resource groups, and comprehensive wellness programs.

review_candidates.title: EMS软件工程师
review_candidates.description: 该职位来源于猎聘 1.EMS系统需求拆解、方案设计、软件架构规划，输出系统规格书、软件设计方案、接口规范、控制策略文档。 2.承担EMS嵌入式软件编码开发、逻辑实现、算法迭代，完成多能源功率分配、工况模式切换、负载管理、冗余保护、故障诊断策略开发。 3.负责船载CAN总线、以太网、串口等通信协议适配，完成EMS与BMS、PLC、推进控制器、配电板、船载监控系统的通信对接与数据交互调试。 4.遵循船舶行业规范与船级社要求，完成软件版本管控、文档归档、变更管理，配合CCS等入级检验、型式试验及项目交付 5.协同硬件、电气、总体、船厂及配套供应商，对接系统集成、现场整改、售后技术支持，持续优化EMS能耗效率、静谧性、可靠性与续航表现。 6.完成公司交办的其他相关工作事项。 任职要求： 1.本科及以上学历，熟悉电力电子与混动原理：交直流配电、DC/DC、逆变整流、并联/串联混动机理、母线稳压、储能充放电控制逻辑。 通信总线原理：CAN2.0、CAN FD、Modbus、船舶以太网、串口通信、报文解析、信号标定、通信故障容错机制。 2.熟悉游艇混动核心部件：船用柴油机、永磁推进电机、船用锂电池、BMS电池管理、船用配电板、逆变模块、岸电系统工作原理及接口定义。 3.掌握中国船级社CCS《混合动力船舶检验指南》、船舶电气、新能源船舶入级规范、海事安全相关标准。 4.熟练CANoe/CANalyzer、示波器、串口调试助手，能独立抓包分析总线报文、定位通信与逻辑问题。
